description: Evaluate bounded typed decisions with TypeSafe AI Jev without replacing the primary Agent model.

assistant_guidance.summary: Use TypeSafe AI for bounded Noul, Choice, or Score decisions when a structured decision is more reliable than free-form model text.
when_to_use: The user asks for a bounded classification, yes/no judgment, ranking, or rubric score.
A retrieval gate, evidence check, or candidate reranking decision needs a structured result.

topics.summary: Answer one bounded yes/no question with a probability.
topics.details: Use typesafe_noul for a binary decision. Keep state and instructions focused. The result is a number from 0 to 1; it is not a natural-language answer.

topics.summary: Select one option from a bounded rubric.
topics.details: Use typesafe_choice when the options are known in advance. Pass criteria as a JSON object mapping each option to a short rubric description or null. Do not use it for open-ended generation.

topics.summary: Score state against an ordered rubric.
topics.details: Use typesafe_score when the rubric has two to ten ordered levels. Pass criteria as a JSON array of level descriptions. Preserve the returned confidence and probabilities when reporting the decision.

endpoint.title: TypeSafe API endpoint
endpoint.description: HTTPS endpoint for a TypeSafe-compatible System One API. A base path is allowed, for example the Vercel AI Gateway base https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/typesafe. Preset to the public TypeSafe service.

token.title: API token
token.description: A TypeSafe API token. It is encrypted after saving and never included in a Run snapshot.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Pinned model version used for reproducible decisions. Use typesafe-ai/jev when connecting through the Vercel AI Gateway.
